assertions.name: conditional_mean_is_not_monotone_at_any_k
assertions.note: every k in 4..26 has inversions; at k=26 there are 184 of 383 consecutive pairs -- about HALF -- with a worst relative jump of 64.0x. Monotone decreasing E[f|C_2] would give the conjecture outright via Cov(h(X),X) <= 0; it is false, and not narrowly

assertions.name: inversions_grow_with_k
assertions.note: 7 (k=10) -> 49 (k=18) -> 184 (k=26): the defect is structural and worsening, not a small-k artifact

assertions.name: no_binning_recovers_monotonicity
assertions.note: neither 8 equal-Plancherel-mass bins nor even 4 are monotone at any k tested. The defect is not resolution-dependent noise

assertions.name: shape_is_a_hump_not_a_decrease
assertions.note: for k >= 14 the 4-bin conditional mean attains its MAXIMUM at an interior bin and its minimum at the top bin. E[f|C_2] rises through the middle and falls only at high C_2 -- so the negativity is a TAIL effect, and the target is a one-sided upper bound on E_P[f|C_2=c] for large c, not a monotone trend

assertions.name: covariance_is_negative_exactly
assertions.note: Cov_P(f, C_2) < 0 on exact rationals at every k -- the conjecture, since G(1) = (k!/|C_3|) Cov_P(f, C_2)

assertions.name: decile_split_reproduces_A_over_B
assertions.note: high-C_2 mass over low-C_2 mass is 0.5727..0.6223, matching `qou-dnev`'s A/B to every printed digit. NOT independent evidence: since chi^lam(3)/f^lam = (C_2-mu)/|C_3| the two sign classes are the same partition of the lambdas and the ratios are equal by identity. This checks that two separately written implementations agree, and nothing more

parameters.claim: conditional-mean monotonicity of E[f|C_2] is false at every resolution; E[f|C_2] is hump-shaped and the negativity is a high-C_2 tail effect

data._grade: exact integer counts; ratios as decimal strings, 4 dp
